title: CWA route policy
description: Versioned, application-owned policy for one route. Admission reads it, and it travels inside the snapshot (R-23). Later milestones add fitting, conflict and evidence fields.

clock_skew_seconds.description: Tolerance for producer clocks: freshness may exceed assembly_time by this much before the item is excluded as future_freshness. Default 0.

producers.description: Producers this route admits, keyed by the identity the application authenticated. Batches from any other producer are refused.

verified.description: For kind mcp only: the route has verified this server, so its output need not be marked untrusted_content (R-15). Default false.

slots.description: Per-slot admission rules; the route's executable eligibility predicate (R-3).

min_relevance.description: Items scoring below this rerank threshold are excluded as below_threshold (R-13). An item with no relevance cannot clear a threshold and is excluded the same way. A score equal to the threshold passes.

max_age_seconds.description: Items observed longer ago than this are excluded: stale_state for state slots (R-8), not_eligible elsewhere. An item exactly this old is still admitted.

required_scope.description: Scope keys an item must carry. Independently of this list, every key an item's scope does carry must equal the request's value for that key; a key the request lacks never matches. A missing key is out_of_scope, never a wildcard.

source_prefix.description: Prefix every item source must start with, e.g. turn: for memory's source turn (R-9).

default_overrides.description: Route replacements for slot defaults, applied when an item omits a policy field (R-3).

tier_upgrades.description: Tiers this route raises above the slot default. Only raising is meaningful; items cannot raise their own (R-16).
